name: multi-deck-blast
description: Chapter 5: 3-deck charge configuration with varying depths for deep fracture and no surface projection

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:6 depth:6 start:20,20
steps.description: The grid tool's spacing stepper defaults to 3m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts); three increment clicks on the strip's spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raise it 3->6m before dragging, so the (20,20)-(26,26) rectangle (6x6) computes the declared 2x2 instead of the default-spacing 3x3 (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4). depth:6 matches the grid tool's own default (DEFAULT_DEPTH_M, Drill.ts) -- this step's interaction array never clicks the depth stepper (data-field="depth"), so the real drag always produces 6m regardless of what's declared (Ground rule #15/Finding #42's class); the file originally declared depth:20 for 'deep fracture' flavor, but a real interaction-mode run at the true 6m depth still produces the exact same PERFECT/0-projections outcome this file's premise describes, confirmed empirically rather than assumed -- so the fix here is only correcting the declared metadata to match reality, no downstream behavior changes.

charge hole:H1 explosive:boomite amount:6 stemming:6 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

charge hole:H2 explosive:boomite amount:5 stemming:5 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

charge hole:H3 explosive:boomite amount:4 stemming:4 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

charge hole:H4 explosive:boomite amount:3 stemming:3 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

expect.note: all 4 per-hole overrides land — Finding #7: the file previously used the bare-numeric hole:1..hole:4 form, which chargeCommand (mining.ts) resolves to the legacy 'hole_1'..'hole_4' id scheme, never matching the real H1..H4 ids drill_plan grid assigns; every charge silently failed (success:false, 'Hole "hole_N" not found', not thrown) and chargedCount stayed 0 through this entire file's history. Fixed by using the real hole ids.

steps.description: blast — downstream of the per-hole varying-charge/stemming setup above (Finding #10, no UI path: Charge.ts has no per-hole control, only Charge All); console `blast` reuses the same validator the Fire step's Execute button gates. Left as a command rather than a click that cannot land (Finding #11).

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero — confirms the blast actually ran (rating PERFECT, 0 projections, matching this file's own 'deep fracture, no surface projection' premise) rather than being silently rejected by validateBlastPlan, which Finding #7's bug would have caused before the hole-id fix
